A joyful, high-speed aerial adventure featuring a cute anthropomorphic penguin pilot and a fluffy corgi co-pilot soaring over a vibrant meadow under bright sunny skies. The scene is rendered in vivid 3D cartoon style with dynamic motion blur and cinematic camera tracking, emphasizing speed and freedom. The lighting is bright, high-contrast daylight with soft shadows, enhancing the playful energy. The camera follows closely from behind and slightly below, maintaining a consistent perspective as they fly forward. The environment bursts with colorful wildflowers and rolling hills, creating a whimsical, immersive world. No transitions or cuts — pure fluid motion.

6 seconds breakdown (one action per second):

第1秒：
The penguin pilot, wearing goggles and a scarf, grips the controls as the corgi co-pilot bursts forward with a blue flame trail, launching off a grassy hill into the sky. Camera follows from behind, low angle, emphasizing the takeoff momentum.

第2秒：
They soar upward, wings flapping in mid-air, as the camera tilts upward slightly to capture the vast sky and fluffy clouds. The corgi’s joyful expression and the penguin’s determined grin convey excitement.

第3秒：
The duo flies level across the meadow, now at cruising speed. The camera tracks smoothly from behind, keeping them centered as wildflowers blur past below. Bright sunlight glints off their gear.

第4秒：
They pass over a cluster of colorful flowers and a lone tree, camera maintaining a steady follow shot. The corgi’s tail wags, and the penguin’s scarf flutters in the wind — playful motion adds to the energy.

第5秒：
The camera pans slightly to the right as they bank gently left, revealing a distant forest and rolling hills. The motion blur intensifies, reinforcing speed and forward momentum.

第6秒：
They fly toward the horizon, the camera pulling back slightly to a medium-wide shot, showing the vast sky and the endless meadow below. The scene ends with them soaring into the clouds, leaving the landscape behind.

Summary:
A seamless, high-energy 6-second flight sequence in 3D cartoon style, featuring a penguin and corgi piloting a whimsical plane across a sunlit meadow. The camera follows with dynamic tracking shots, capturing joyful motion, vibrant scenery, and bright daylight. No cuts or transitions — pure cinematic flow from launch to horizon.

默认情况下，我们使用720p分辨率。如果你有强大的GPU，可以尝试1920*1088。

# Using LoRAs
**Ctrl + B to enable**

For the camera LoRA we recommend setting strength = 1

You can use LTX [Ready to use camera LoRAs](https://huggingface.co/collections/Lightricks/ltx-2)




Use a second LoRa only when the details are important in the LoRa. 

## Training
We have made available a full trainer to help you to train your own LoRA. You can [find it here](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2).

widgets_values:
结合我加载的图片，给出接下来的提示词描述。要求动作连贯，剧情合理。并提供6秒拆解，按每秒拆解。时长符合动作的逻辑，提示词要简洁，人物乘坐柯基飞机向前高速飞行，镜头跟随，要描述场景细节，不要叠化转场过渡，要符合逻辑，你需要输出英文。

光源类型 为日光、人工光、月光、实用光、火光、荧光、阴天光、混合光、晴天光等
光线类型 可以描述为柔光、硬光、顶光、侧光、背光、底光、边缘光、剪影、低对比度、高对比度
时间段 白天、夜晚、黄昏、日落、黎明、日出。
景别 特写、近景、中景，中近景、中全景、全景、广角
描述构图类型 中心构图、平衡构图、侧重构图、对称构图、短边构图
镜头描述-镜头尺寸 中焦距、广角、长焦、望远、超广角-鱼眼
镜头描述-镜头角度 过肩角度、高角度、低角度、倾斜角度、航拍、俯视角度
镜头描述-镜头类型 单人镜头、双人镜头、三人镜头、群像镜头、定场镜头
色调 暖色调、冷色调、高饱和度、低饱和度等。
运动描述 跳舞、跑步、滑滑板、踢足球、网球、乒乓、滑雪、篮球、橄榄球、顶碗舞、侧手翻等。
人物情绪 愤怒、恐惧、高兴、悲伤、惊讶。
基础运镜 镜头推进、镜头拉远、镜头向右移动、镜头向左移动、 镜头上摇 高级运镜 手持镜头、复合运镜、跟随镜头、环绕运镜
风格化-视觉风格 毛毡风格、3D卡通、像素风格、木偶动画、3D游戏、黏土风格、二次元、水彩画、黑白动画、油画风格 风格化-特效镜头 移轴摄影、延时拍摄

按照总分总的模板，你需要输出英文，先总体描述，再按秒拆分，每秒只需一段话，最后再总结，如下面例子。
例子：”
xxxxxxxxxxx


6秒拆解（每秒动作与镜头描述）：

第1秒：
xxxxxxxxxxxxx

第2秒：
xxxxxxxxxxxxxx

第3秒：
xxxxxxxxxxxx


总结“
